purpose: One frozen temporal pilot of a shallow L1 residual correction head on the V2 three-component champion.

incumbent.recipe: 0.5625 LGB SVD32 + 0.1875 Hybrid Ridge + 0.25 sparse LGB rank50
incumbent.source: original row-exact mapped component caches; no end-51 synthetic champion
incumbent.sparse_policy: within-cycle average-rank blend 0.5 raw + 0.5 percentile, clipped [0,100]
incumbent.base_policy: cached past-only component mappings and fixed Ridge25 blend, verified row-by-row

temporal_protocol.pilot_primary_pooled: W1 unchanged plus W4 corrected; disjoint rows, non-consecutive windows, report as two-window policy summary only
temporal_protocol.pilot_H12_pooled: H12_E unchanged plus H12_L corrected; overlapping temporal views and not independent replication
temporal_protocol.W2_W3: training blocks for the one E67 head; report incumbent/baseline only, do not evaluate corrected outputs on training labels

score_labels: threat_rank minus incumbent prediction is the head training residual; prediction is incumbent + 0.5 * learned correction, clipped [0,100].

selection_gate.improvement: at least one of pilot_primary_pooled or pilot_H12_pooled has candidate MAE lower than baseline
selection_gate.harm_guard: W4 and H12_L candidate MAE harm must each be <= 0.5
selection_gate.subgroups: report bias, EF, stream availability, and target tails descriptively; no tail routing

boundaries.early_oof_boundary: end-51 component caches are raw predecessor predictions; their rank policy used 52-55 labels and no sparse-LGB component exists at cutoff51, so they are excluded from head fit.
